rules.description: Active FeedingAmerica_MapMealGap StatVars meet place count, observation count, and annual freshness lag checks.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, NumPlaces, NumObservations, CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) AS LatestDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar != 'Count_Person_FoodInsecure_EligibleForSomeFederalBenefits'
params.condition: NumPlaces >= 3190 AND NumObservations >= 22000 AND LatestDate >= GREATEST(2024, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 3)

rules.description: Historical StatVar Count_Person_FoodInsecure_EligibleForSomeFederalBenefits (2018-2020) meets place, observation, and date checks.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, NumPlaces, NumObservations, CAST(MaxDate AS INTEGER) AS LatestDate FROM stats WHERE StatVar = 'Count_Person_FoodInsecure_EligibleForSomeFederalBenefits'
